visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a black top and a cream-colored skirt, stands in front of a modern storefront with a large glass window that has the words "Eternal Aesthetic Clinic" and "Beauty with Me" printed on it. She holds a takeaway coffee cup and smiles warmly at the camera. (2) A brief cutaway shows a busy urban street in Taipei with the iconic Taipei 101 skyscraper visible in the distance under an overcast sky; pedestrians and vehicles are seen at a crosswalk. (3) The woman enters the clinic, pointing to the glowing circular logo on the wall next to the automatic glass doors. Inside, she approaches a sleek, minimalist reception desk with two monitors where a staff member is seated against a grey wall with lit-up clinic signage. (4) In a comfortable lounge area with blue and grey modern sofas, a staff member hands the woman a cup of tea and a snack; she excitedly shows a yellow-packaged Korean biscuit to the camera. (5) The woman walks through a brightly lit hallway with white vertical lines and enters a consultation room labeled 'Consultation D'. (6) Inside the room, she sits across from a female consultant in a white lab coat; they review documents in a folder, and the consultant gently touches the woman's cheek to assess her skin. (7) A transition shows a modern staircase with neon lighting and an abstract painting of a girl with a pearl earring. (8) The woman lies on a treatment bed with a grey pillow and a white blanket; a staff member in a black uniform and gloves begins a facial treatment. (9) Close-ups show a specialized skin treatment device with blue and silver tips moving across her forehead, nose, and chin, applying a wet solution to the skin. (10) A glass container is shown filled with murky water, implying extracted impurities from the skin; the woman looks into a silver hand mirror, appearing pleased with her glowing complexion. (11) A thick white cream mask is applied to her face with a pink spatula, which is later peeled off in one piece. (12) The video concludes with the woman back outside in front of the clinic's large blue window, walking confidently and posing for the camera while holding her drink.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main creator (female), 1 receptionist (female), 1 consultant (female), 1 treatment staff (female), and approximately 4 male/female pedestrians in the street background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with long, straight dark brown hair, wearing a black v-neck long-sleeve top and a high-waisted pale yellow midi skirt. She wears black boots and occasionally sunglasses on her head.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts on an urban sidewalk in front of a clinic with large black and glass facade. A transition shows the Taipei city skyline with Taipei 101. The interior of the clinic is minimalist with curved grey walls, modern lighting, and a clinical but upscale lounge and treatment room.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, rhythmic acoustic guitar and percussion BGM at a steady 110 BPM. A high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice narrates the introduction over a backdrop of subtle urban ambient traffic noise. (2) As the setting moves indoors, the ambient noise drops to studio silence. The narrator's tone remains friendly and bright, describing the clinic's location and atmosphere. (3) During the consultation phase, a second female voice with a professional, calm tone is briefly heard in dialogue with the main narrator. (4) In the treatment phase, a rhythmic mechanical humming sound from the skincare device becomes audible, mixed with the ongoing music and narration. (5) As the face mask is peeled, a distinct but soft fabric rustling sound (SFX) is heard. (6) The video ends with a high-energy closing statement from the narrator, with the BGM swelling slightly in volume before a hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Arrival -> Consultation -> Procedure -> Result -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional vlog designed to showcase the professional services and upscale environment of the Eternal Aesthetic Clinic in Taipei. It aims to build trust through the demonstration of a clinical facial treatment (HydraFacial) and highlight the 'Korean-style' aesthetic to appeal to young female viewers interested in skincare.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator provides a first-person review, names the specific clinic in the title and subtitles, and encourages viewers to visit and try the service themselves.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-quality urban imagery of Taipei and polished interior clinic shots to create a luxury brand image. The rhythmic synchronization of the narration with the visual procedural steps enhances the informative quality.
